digest.component_or_area: Container plan-review attestation and drift-scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` is neutral: it contributes no paths and does not poison sibling path declarations or inheritance
Any live `undeclared` child poisons child inheritance, prevents all-none promotion, and forces conservative unscoped fallback when no parent/citation paths exist
Scope precedence is exact: own/cited/inherited paths yield `paths`; explicit parent `none` yields `none`; all-live-children-none promotes only `undeclared` parent to `none`; otherwise `unscoped`
P9 passes leaves and containers with all live children declared; it advises only live `undeclared` children and names both path declaration and `--none` as truthful remedies
Cheap resign preserves the same child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshot without network reads
Mixed live `paths` and `none` children inherit only path child dependencies, survive unrelated drift, and become stale only when declared child paths change
